mgmt_bio.text: (BMV: KOFUBL; NYSE: KOF), the largest Coca-Cola franchise bottler in the world by sales volume. He was appointed by the company's board in October 2022, effective January 2023, succeeding John Santa Maria; he had been with the FEMSA group for 28 years, holding increasing responsibilities at Coca-Cola FEMSA since 2003, and served as CEO of Coca-Cola FEMSA Brazil from 2016. Earlier senior roles included chief operating officer of Brazil and of Argentina, CFO and strategic planning director of the South America division, CFO, planning and corporate affairs director for the Mercosur region, and corporate finance and treasury director of Coca-Cola FEMSA. He continues to lead the company's quarterly investor calls alongside CFO Gerardo Cruz, including for second-quarter 2026 results.
